Definition: a strengthened form of G1485; usage, i.e. (plural) moral habits:--manners.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, ēthos means usage, that is moral habits. It occurs just once, in 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold ēthos to its plain sense and let the passage speak for itself.
